# Ibrahim Haykal Alatas

> Full Stack Developer based in Jakarta, Indonesia. Builds enterprise CRM and manufacturing/warehouse systems with Laravel and React, on top of legacy ERP environments (Infor/Baan). Holds an Applied Bachelor of Computer Science (S.Tr.Kom) from Politeknik STMI Jakarta, Ministry of Industry, GPA 3.77/4.00.

Skilled in REST API design, role-based access systems, AI feature integration,
inventory traceability, and modern component-based frontend architectures.
Currently open to Full Stack Developer and Backend Developer roles.

## Education

- Thesis: *Implementation of a Steel Sheet Monitoring Information System to Improve Material Search Efficiency at PT Gemala Kempa Daya* — reduced warehouse material search and information retrieval time by 76.10% (103.00 to 24.62 minutes), validated via time study over 30 measurement cycles.

## Experience

- [Full Stack Developer, Datapolis (PT Data Teknologi Terintegrasi)](https://ibrahimhaykal.my.id/#experience): Jun 2026 – Present, Jakarta. Develops VALAK CRM, an actuarial consulting CRM platform, using Laravel 12 and React 19 across authentication, master data, calculation, and reporting modules. Built role-based dashboards and task/todo management for admin, sales (AM), marketing, data, actuary, and finance roles, plus an internal dashboard for the actuarial team. Developed calculation submission and progress tracking, integrating calculation APIs and per-PIC company dropdown endpoints. Integrated AI-powered summary insights (Kimi AI for NirmaAI) and a data-labeling API for role-based document management. Implemented login, PIC management, group management CRUD, client–group linking, revision-note chatroom for report review, and project ID/number administration APIs.
- [Full Stack Developer / System Engineer Intern, PT Gemala Kempa Daya (Astra Otoparts Group)](https://ibrahimhaykal.my.id/#experience): Feb 2025 – Jun 2026, Jakarta. Developed a FIFO floor-storage warehouse monitoring system supporting 48 material blocks and 400+ weekly transactions with QR gate in/out, digital block visualization, and supply scheduling, reducing material search cycle time by 76.10% from 103.00 to 24.62 minutes. Built a finished goods visualization system for Giant Rack Plant 3, mapping 80+ rack columns across multi-layer, top, and side U-shape layouts with customer filtering, barcode scanning, and shipment status tracking. Built inventory aging and LMB reporting for accounting reconciliation, supporting 30,000+ row multi-sheet Excel exports in around 9 seconds with drill-down tracing. Designed Smart Andon maintenance monitoring with QR validation, lifecycle tracking, and MTTR visibility. Developed maintenance cost approval workflows covering sparepart usage, COA classification, asset submission, and multi-level approval. Executed a phased Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration for the Trucking Control System using an application-level dual-write strategy with zero downtime.
- [Web Developer, Nirmala Technology](https://ibrahimhaykal.my.id/#experience): Aug 2024 – Jan 2025, Jakarta. Developed a QR-based restaurant ordering system with cart, checkout, order tracking, Midtrans payment webhook, and admin dashboard. Built coliving and cafe event booking with room/event availability, deposit payment via Midtrans, payment status polling, webhook handling, email notification, and role-based admin CMS. Delivered a bilingual corporate profile platform on Laravel 11 and responsive component-based UI for the Q-Tin Dashboard using DaisyUI and Flowbite.
